trend: Wearable ultrasound patch put people into REM 43 minutes sooner, 28 participants
why: Read-past-the-headline education in our evidence-first voice, on a tiny study.
text:
A wearable ultrasound patch got people into REM 43 minutes sooner.

The study had 28 participants. That makes it interesting and early, and nowhere near advice for your bedtime.

Small studies are how big ideas start. We wait for the bigger ones before we build anything on them.
